description:
[read-only] Status of an async job (combine_clips, render_motion_ad, or an API video generation): pending, processing, completed or failed. For a combine or a motion ad, `resultContentId` is the new draft once completed; a failed combine is refunded automatically. Poll every 10-30 s — renders take about a minute.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/generate/status/{jobId}.)
name: get_job_status
title: Get a render/generation job status
